title: Speed at N
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the speed at point N using work-energy theorem: v_N = sqrt(2Eql/m).

title: Speed at P
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the speed at point P, which must be v_P = 2*sqrt(Eql/m).

title: Potential Energy Change
description: Essential: Correctly states the change in electric potential energy from M to P as ΔU = -2Eql.

title: P Coordinate
description: Essential: Correctly identifies the x-coordinate of point P as 2l.

title: Work-Energy Application
description: Important: Applies the work-energy theorem correctly for motion in each quadrant or overall.

title: Motion Decomposition
description: Important: Analyzes the motion in the first quadrant as projectile-like, with constant horizontal velocity and uniform vertical acceleration.

title: Geometry Relation
description: Important: Uses the given tanθ = 1/2 to relate the vertical and horizontal displacements in the first quadrant.

title: Sign Error in Potential
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns the sign for the change in electric potential energy (e.g., positive instead of negative).

title: Kinematics Mix-up
description: Pitfall: Misapplies kinematic equations, e.g., using wrong acceleration direction or confusing motion between quadrants.

title: Unit Consistency Check
description: Optional: Demonstrates dimensional analysis to verify the units of final answers are consistent.
